title: Test-Weakening Config
description: Per-project override file for `sense test-weakening` thresholds. Lives at `.devai/config/test-weakening.json` (optional; absence means use D-21 defaults). Per D-21 evolution in Phase 16.F: defaults are educated guesses; per-project measurement refines them empirically.

threshold_ratio.description: Decrease ratio above which an assertion-count drop in a changed test file is flagged as unjustified weakening. D-21 default: 0.20 (a 20% decrease in a file's assertion count fires).

absolute_decrease_floor.description: Minimum absolute decrease that always fires, regardless of ratio. D-21 default: 1 (any assertion removed in a file is a warning even if the ratio is below threshold_ratio).

skip_added_threshold.description: Number of new `.skip` / `.only` / `.todo` annotations in a single file that triggers a finding. D-21 default: 1.

invariant_reference_removed_threshold.description: Number of `INV-*` references removed from test files in a single diff that triggers a finding. D-21 default: 1.

ignored_paths.description: Glob patterns for test files exempt from weakening checks. Useful for legitimate test deprecations (e.g., a feature being removed). Each ignored path SHOULD have a corresponding entry in the project's CHANGELOG explaining the deprecation.
